verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird's own venture capital practice page says it advises high-growth companies through funding rounds 'ultimately through to an exit (including M&A transactions, secondary buyouts and IPOs)'. Its TwoVenture hub also has an 'Exit & Beyond' section. These are first-party statements of exit capability, but the pack shows no exit deal examples, no IPO track record and no dedicated M&A or capital-markets pages for venture-backed companies, so the depth of that experience is unproven. Missing for 10: documented exit/IPO deal examples or track record, dedicated M&A and public-offering practice detail for venture-backed clients, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm can carry the company through to exit — M&A and public-offering experience for venture-backed companies is documented on its own pages

citations.quote: ultimately through to an exit (including M&A transactions, secondary buyouts and IPOs)
A hub to provide guidance to start-up and scale-up companies and their investors through the venture capital life cycle
